summary: Azul S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that on May 5, 2026, its Board of Directors, upon the resignation of Independent Member James Jason Grant, approved the appointment of Sérgio Eraldo de Salles Pinto as an Independent Member of the Statutory Audit Committee for a term ending May 2, 2027. The committee now consists of Mr. Peralta (Coordinator), Mr. Salles Pinto, and Ms. Ribeiro. Mr. Salles Pinto and Mr. Peralta were determined to qualify as audit committee financial experts. This is a routine governance update, not a special situation.
